f.pu: To preserve the marine ecosystems present in the Desventuradas Islands ecoregion, as well as those associated with seamounts that constitute part of the Salas y Gómez and Nazca Mountain Ranges and the existing aquatic biota in the area subject to protection.
f.re: All extractive activity of resources is prohibited. In accordance with Decree 238, in marine parks, no activity may be carried out, except those that are authorized for observation, research or study purposes in the sectors previously determined.
